name: capture-markdown
title: Markshot
description: Capture a screen region as structured Markdown using your signed-in Codex CLI or OpenAI API.
author: hannes

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: AI Provider
preferences.description: Codex uses its existing login. OpenAI API uses your own API key; providers never switch automatically.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex Command Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path or ~/ path. Leave empty to find the installed codex command.

preferences.name: codexModel
preferences.title: Codex Model
preferences.description: Default: gpt-6-luna, also used when blank. Fast mode enabled (2.5x subscription usage). Set another vision-capable Codex model if needed.

preferences.name: codexReasoningEffort
preferences.title: Codex Reasoning Effort
preferences.description: Codex only. Default: Low for faster transcription. Medium spends more time reasoning about the screenshot.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Only needed when AI Provider is OpenAI API

preferences.name: openaiModel
preferences.title: OpenAI Model
preferences.description: Vision-capable Responses API model, only used with OpenAI API

commands.name: capture-markdown
commands.title: Capture Region as Markdown
commands.description: Capture a selected screen area and copy structured markdown to clipboard

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "Use npm run publish to publish to Raycast Store" && exit 1
